name: Goblet cell
short_description: Goblet-shaped mucus producer in gut and airways. Releases mucin packets that form a protective gel over the epithelium.

textbook.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; unmistakable wine-glass/goblet silhouette, basal nucleus with rough ER/mitochondria/Golgi correctly placed in the narrow stem, apical cup packed with many separate pale mucin granules, sparse apical microvilli fringe, muted textbook palette, thin outlines, dark charcoal background, no border)

sem.1: fail (gemini-2.5-flash-image, goblet cell rendered as a balloon on a thin disconnected stalk floating above the neighbouring cells - reads as a lollipop, not an embedded epithelial cell)
sem.2: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; goblet cell correctly embedded within the epithelial sheet, dome bulging above flatter neighbours with rounded granule-swellings under the surface and sparse microvilli, rose/coral false colour vs cooler tan neighbours, no internal organelles shown, no border)

3d.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; clear goblet silhouette, soft cut-away with translucent membrane and subsurface scattering, basal nucleus/rough ER/mitochondria/Golgi correctly in the stem, many pearlescent mucin granules in the apical cup, natural biological tones, no border)
